about: lora_pullback (2026-10-20): the pull-back with LoRA-shaped rank-8 offsets on all 24 decomposed matrices, on the emoticon task, under round 2's Pile adversary. Round 4 ran it on one matrix only (Pile PGD ratio 2.1-4.1) while the free all-matrix pull-back sat at the floor (1.10): is the fragility the rank constraint or the confinement? The user's question ('I want to test lora pullback'), backlog entry 2026-10-20; design check confirmed by the user 2026-10-20. Filed before any arm was trained.

blind_to.Pile PGD ratio: a trigger-specific attack (the adversary is shared over 65k Pile positions holding ~3 triggers); the 20-step search is chaotic across GPUs, so cross-card comparisons are reported only
blind_to.controls: G3 (the harness sees a fragile state on this card), G4 (same-card references reproduce)
blind_to.seed pair: two seeds give a spread, not a distribution; a verdict needs both seeds on the same side of a line

expected_at.W0: every ratio 1 by construction; floor f 0.05-0.21
expected_at.control pb_r8_site: >= 1.5 (round 4: 4.06 on a 4090; 4090 PGD read 35% above the L40 on round 2's lift)
expected_at.pb_all: PGD ratio about 1.07 (round 2, L40), P(o) about 0.996, kl_other about 0.009

gates.rule: f from W0's 3 seeds; state spread s = |PGD ratio(pb_r8_all seed 0) - (seed 1)|

gates.if_fail: the arm is reported, not scored
gates.rule: pb_r8_all finds an lr by the rule and seed 1 reaches P(o) >= 0.9 at it; pb_r8_site, pb_all and the LoRA reach P(o) >= 0.9

gates.if_fail: the pull-back's state bookkeeping is wrong; stop
the harness does not see round 4's fragile state on this card: P1 and P2 are reported, not scored
find the cause before the analysis; on another card G4 is reported, not applied
gates.rule: on an L40 only: LoRA lift PGD ratio within 5% of 1.128 (same code, seed and card as round 5); pb_all within 25% of 1.07 (round 2)

measurements.delta_change: harness.measure's share of ||delta-W||^2 that Delta absorbed: 0 by construction for every pull-back
measurements.kl_other: held-out KL to W0 away from the trigger at the scored step, reported beside every PGD ratio (the reading-A round found PGD excess ordering with kl_other)
measurements.pgd_floor: f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over the 3 adversary seeds (round 5 on an L40: 0.21)
measurements.pile: faithfulness.pile_faithfulness (2 blocks of 128 val rows 0..255, one adversary per block, 20 steps of 0.1); ratio = state / W0 under adversary seed 0; the PGD ratio is the scored number
measurements.routes: local_faith.route_split at the trigger: reported, not scored (mechanism, not the pass criterion)

predictions.neither: otherwise (between the lines, or the seeds on opposite sides)
predictions.null: both seeds' PGD ratio >= 2.0 (round 4's one-matrix range)
predictions.predicted: pass: spread over 24 matrices at the lr rule's smallest passing lr, each matrix moves far less than round 4's single matrix did, and the free all-matrix pull-back with the same support sits at the floor
predictions.reported: kl_other beside the ratio, against pb_all's and the LoRA's; if null, whether its kl_other exceeds pb_all's

predictions.predicted: pass: round 4's fragility came from putting the whole update on one matrix the decomposition reads badly (21% of its input energy), not from the rank-8 shape

reported_not_scored: every arm's P(o), kl_other, rel_norm_max, stochastic/CI-masked/unmasked Pile ratios and route shares; the pb_r8_all lr sweep; pb_all vs pb_r8_all (rank constraint at matched support); the LoRA lift beside the LoRA-shaped pull-back (the two maps on a LoRA-shaped update)

setup.W0: the released decomposition under round 2's Pile harness with adversary seeds (0, 1, 2)
setup.lora: rank-8 LoRA on all 24 matrices, lr 0.001, checkpoints (1, 2, 3, 5, 10), scored at the first with P(o) >= 0.9; lifted (lift.lift_state) and do-nothing, as round 5
setup.pb_all: free offsets on all 24 matrices, lr 1e-05 (round 2's and the ladder's arm), 30 steps
setup.pb_r8_all: pullback.train on all 24 matrices with rank-8 offsets dU = P S^T, dV = Q T^T (P, Q zero init; S, T ~ N(0, 1/n)), Gamma and Delta frozen, arm A's loss, batch 32, clip 1, Adam, 30 steps; lr = the smallest in (1e-05, 3e-05, 0.0001, 0.0003, 0.001) with held-out P(o) >= 0.9 and kl_other <= 0.11 at the last step (round 4's rule; none passing = did not learn, reported at the highest-P(o) lr). Seed 1 (offset init and batches) repeated at seed 0's lr
setup.pb_r8_site: the same on h.2.mlp.down_proj only, lr 0.0003 (round 4's selected lr for pb_r8, Pile PGD 4.06 on a 4090)
setup.windows: round 1's emoticon windows (365 train, 73 held-out, trigger at index 20, target token `o`)
